note: Steps of the Cordova settings code on iOS. A trace lists what a step did, in order: TwStorage.set (what it stores), $http (the request; Push.updateUnits's list post carries /v000902, the native app sends /v000903, #2948), $broadcast, WeatherInfo.reloadCity, $location.path, toggleLeft (the menu closes), InAppBrowser.open and $ionicPopup.alert. `location` is the string the mail row assigns to window.location.href. Units start from the Korean defaults; the stored push list is `pushList` with token `token-a` unless a push case says otherwise; `now` is the clock of the request's timezoneOffset.
